harnesses.description: The harnesses the project is set up for, each named for its binary. codefall still reads claude-code and antigravity, the names claude and agy had before, and codefall init rewrites them.

agents.description: The agents a verb reaches for when it needs another reader, in order (ADR-009): a reviewer, or a second opinion on a decision a run cannot settle. Each is named for a person to type after via=, runs on a harness named for its binary or on current, the harness running the session, and may name a model, passed to that harness untouched. Absent means one agent, subagent on current, which codefall init writes explicitly.

agentsByHarness.description: The order a session walks when it is running in the named harness, as names from agents. A harness with no entry, or a session that cannot say which harness it is in, walks the top-level order.

agents.description: The order review walks, as names from agents, when it differs from the top-level order.

consult.description: What a verb reaches for when a run cannot settle a question on its own (ADR-009): a second opinion that proposes and never decides.

agents.description: The order a consult walks, as names from agents, when it differs from the top-level order.

local.description: The project's local-environment commands, each a shell command run from the project root (ADR-005).

start.description: Brings up what the project needs running locally. Idempotent.

update.description: Makes the local environment match the checkout. Idempotent; may assume start has run.

test.description: What the project has declared about its test cases: where they live, and which runners are installed (ADR-007).

dir.description: The testing root, relative to the directory holding .codefall/. codefall init asks for it and defaults to testing.

runners.description: The spec runners the project has installed, written by codefall-equip rather than by hand.
